clip_evidence.title: Olivia Dean - Wish I Didn't Miss You (Angie Stone) | Mahogany Session
clip_evidence.recording_context_notes: Single-room Mahogany live session with visible vocal mic bleed, natural room decay, and acoustic guitar accompaniment.

observations.musical_choice: Replaces Angie Stone's heavy drum-loop groove with muted, syncopated acoustic guitar chord stabs, leaving wide space around the lead vocal.
Delays the chorus hook entrance slightly behind the guitar downbeat and clips the line endings conversationally instead of belting.

clip_evidence.title: Olivia Dean - Love Me Not in the Live Lounge
clip_evidence.recording_context_notes: Live radio studio performance with live band interplay and unedited vocal breath transitions.

observations.musical_choice: Reshapes Ravyn Lenae's brisk falsetto melody in a warmer chest-mix register with relaxed jazz-soul swing.

clip_evidence.title: Allen Stone - Is This Love (Bob Marley Cover) | Mahogany Session
clip_evidence.recording_context_notes: Unaccompanied solo hollowbody guitar and live room vocal in an intimate single-camera session.

observations.musical_choice: Slows Bob Marley's reggae skank into a rubato 6/8 soul ballad, stretching vowel turns across barlines.
Builds from a hushed head-voice confession into an uncompressed gospel chest-voice peak while palm-muting the guitar.

clip_evidence.title: Allen Stone - Is This Love (Official Video) (Bob Marley Cover)
clip_evidence.recording_context_notes: Multi-tracked studio production with rhythm section, organ pad, and polished vocal compression.

observations.musical_choice: Locks the same harmonic reharmonization into a slow-burn Memphis soul pocket, confirming the reinterpretation is structural rather than accidental.

clip_evidence.title: YEBBA - My Mind | Sofar NYC
clip_evidence.recording_context_notes: Intimate seated Sofar NYC room recording with audible crowd stillness and zero vocal pitch-correction artifacts.

observations.musical_choice: Drops to an almost whispered pianissimo on the refrain before blooming into resonant chest tone without stepping closer to the mic.
Suspends the resolution with an intricate descending melisma that lands cleanly on the root as the guitar holds a bare chord.

clip_evidence.title: Acantha Lang - Ride This Train | Sofar London
clip_evidence.recording_context_notes: Live ensemble Sofar London performance with horns and rhythm section.

observations.musical_choice: Drives classic Southern-soul grit against tight horn stabs with commanding call-and-response phrasing.

assessments.fit_rationale: Extraordinary live dynamic control and phrasing elasticity in a stripped NYC listening room (clip_05 @ 1:22 & 3:55), though evaluated here from a single original ballad clip.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 1:12 in her live Mahogany take of Angie Stone's 'Wish I Didn't Miss You', she lays behind the muted acoustic guitar groove and turns an iconic belt chorus into an intimate, conversational confession.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Open her BBC Live Lounge take of 'Love Me Not' (@ 0:48) to hear how she applies the same warm chest-mix swing to a modern uptempo R&B track.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 0:42, he strips Bob Marley's 'Is This Love' down to a single hollowbody guitar and rubato 6/8 phrasing, completely reframing the lyric's emotional weight before swelling dynamically at 2:38.
shortlist.what_to_hear_next: Compare with the studio version (@ 1:04) to hear how the reharmonization translates to a full Memphis-soul rhythm section, then check an original live take.

shortlist.why_it_fits: At 1:22 in her Sofar NYC room session, she drops to a pin-drop whisper and swells into full chest resonance on a single breath, demonstrating elite live micro-dynamics without studio polish.
